description: Sound has long captured the imaginations of artists as a unique and expressive medium with which to create soundscapes, interactive art, sculptures, installations, film, custom instruments, and as accompaniment to painting. In this topics course, we will look at the history and evolution of sound as an artistic and interdisciplinary medium with which to tell stories, conduct research, and create artwork and spaces. Students will develop a variety of projects through field recording and electronic sound generation, spatialized audio design, data sonification, and sound installation that may intersect with other media. Prerequisite: ARTS 104.
